name: rogue class
mana cost: {U}{B}
types: enchantment class
level[1]: whenever a creature you control deals combat damage to a player, exile the top card of that player's library face down. you may look at it for as long as it remains exiled.
level[2]: {1}{U}{B}: creatures you control have menace.
level[3]: {2}{U}{B}: you may play cards exiled with CARDNAME, and you may spend mana as though it were mana of any color to cast those spells.
